offering_description.value: Operates the Bumble dating and friendship apps and the Badoo dating app, selling premium subscriptions and in-app features to individual adult users. Users download the apps for free, and revenue comes mainly from paid tiers and in-app purchases delivered through mobile app stores.

primary_products.value: dating app; friendship app; social networking app

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual adults seeking romantic partners, friends or social connections

end_markets.value: consumer dating; social networking; online advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: premium tiers with extra matching and visibility features; transaction or usage fees: in-app purchases such as boosts and extra swipes; advertising: ads shown to users of the free versions of the apps
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs the matching apps and takes in user subscriptions and in-app payments, sold directly to consumers

geography_served.value: global: worldwide, with large user bases in North America, Europe and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: dating app, friendship app, social networking app sharing users and technology

distribution_channels.value: online: iOS and Android app stores and the company websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer data privacy and online safety rules, such as GDPR, and app store payment rules
